in_english.name: Mpho
in_english.long_meaning: Mpho is a gift of knowledge and perception. It is a name that represents the ability to understand and respond to the world around us. In a spiritual context, Mpho represents the ability to receive and understand God's word. The name Mpho is also associated with the qualities of intelligence, wisdom, and discernment. It is a name that is rich in meaning and significance, and is often given to children born into Christian families.
